---
title: "About me"
---

Hello, I'm a Senior Research Fellow and Senior Lecturer in the School of Education and Society, Faculty of Education and School of Social and Political Sciences, Faculty of Arts at the University of Melbourne.

My research focuses on inequality, social class, curriculum and qualifications.
I use statistical and qualitative methods and explore social phenomena historically.

I teach undergraduate and graduate courses in research methods and education.

You can find out more about my work on the [Publications](publications.qmd)
and [Teaching](teaching.qmd) pages, or get in touch by email (icon top right).
